name: Arcane Bolt
description: Hurls a focused lance of raw ether at the lead foe in an enemy group.

name: Slumber Mist
description: Blankets an enemy group in soporific vapor, putting foes to Sleep until struck.

name: Lumina Orb
description: Conjures a hovering globe of mage-light for 30 steps, warding off ambushes.

name: Cinder Burst
description: Detonates a sphere of crimson flame across every foe in an enemy group.

name: Aegis Ward
description: Weaves a shimmering arcane barrier around the party (+2 AC for this battle).

name: Nullifying Hex
description: Seals the vocal cords and arcane channels of an enemy group, preventing spellcasting and specials.

name: Tempest Arc
description: Calls down fork-lightning that arcs through every living enemy on the battlefield.

name: Ethereal Recall
description: Folds space to teleport the party out of danger or directly to the gates of Oakhaven.

name: Astral Meteor
description: Tears open the firmament to rain starfire across all enemy formations.

name: Sanctuary Touch
description: Channels warm Triad grace to knit wounds and restore HP to a living ally.

name: Purify Spirit
description: Cleanses Poison, Sleep, Paralysis, and Silence from an ally and restores 1d4 HP.

name: Sunbeam Smite
description: Sears a foe with solar radiance (deals 1.5x damage against Undead).

name: Benediction
description: Chants a battle hymn that grants +2 AC and +2 Hit bonus to the entire party.

name: Chains of Light
description: Shackles an enemy group in radiant fetters, inflicting Paralysis.

name: Greater Mend
description: Restores substantial HP to a living ally and purges active status ailments.

name: Hymn of Dawn
description: Bathes the entire party in golden dawnlight, healing all living heroes and curing Poison / Sleep / Silence.

name: Breath of Life
description: Calls a fallen (Dead) hero's soul back from the threshold with restored HP.

name: Judgment of the Triad
description: Unleashes sacred wrath across all enemy groups while mending all living party members.
